    How it works

    The booking flow is built around clear states, so both sides always know where things stand.

    Choose
    Pick a vendor and package.
    Request
    Send event details and ask for a quote.
    Compare

    Confirm
    Availability is checked before booking.
    Run the day
    Track tasks, vendors and guests live.

    FAQ


    Is this the full backend application?

    This site is the interactive frontend experience. Data here is sample data in your browser. The FastAPI + PostgreSQL backend from the spec is the next build step.

    Do payments work here?

    No. Razorpay will be added in test mode with server-side signature checks. Nothing here marks a booking paid.

    What does the Verified badge mean?

    An admin has reviewed the vendor's business documents. It does not reflect customer ratings.

    Can I run several events?

    Yes. Each event keeps its own tasks, guests, budget and vendors.
